name: Charlotte, NC
subtitle: Queen City's rising food scene — from Kindred to the classics
items: Kindred (Davidson, Joe & Katy Kindred — James Beard, best restaurant in NC)
Leah & Louise (Camp North End, Grace Perkins — James Beard nom., stunning Black Southern cooking)
Haymaker (Uptown, seasonal, Aaron Cozart — Charlotte's most celebrated)
Supperland (Plaza Midwood, Emily Doyle — church converted to restaurant)
Good Food on Montford (South End, farm to table, Kevin Blankenship)
Soul Gastrolounge (Elizabeth, creative global small plates)
Futo Buta (South End, Japanese ramen + izakaya)
Optimist (South End, Georgia-style fish camp, Top Chef's Ford Fry)
McNinch House Restaurant (Uptown, Victorian mansion, prix fixe — special occasions only)
Midwood Smokehouse (multiple, NC BBQ done properly)
Summit Coffee (Davidson — grab the cinnamon roll)
